title: Voting: API reachability and process
description: Observations made from outside the application process. This is deliberately not a RED dashboard: per-request request-rate and error-ratio series do not exist in this deployment, and a dashboard that promises them while showing empty panels is worse than one that does not. See Task 2.3 in the plan for why adding request-level instrumentation was out of scope.

panels.title: Probe success
panels.description: 1 when the health endpoint answered 200 to an external probe. This is the only check that survives the application dying: a process that has stopped also stops exporting, so its last exported values stay frozen and every panel built on them keeps looking healthy.

panels.title: Probe duration
panels.description: How long the health endpoint took to answer, measured from outside. The endpoint reads the chain and the index, so rising latency is the first symptom of either -- it appears well before requests start failing.

panels.title: Scrape target up
panels.description: Prometheus's own view of whether each configured target answered. Covers the exporters as well as the app, so a monitor that has died is reported rather than silently believed.

panels.title: Server resident memory
panels.description: Reported by the application itself. Worth watching beside the probe panels because a slow leak shows up here first, and the container's memory limit is what turns a leak into a restart.
